pitch_headline: A SuperSite backed by 12 five-star reviews and a clear niche position.
pitch_body: This version of the SuperSite for Seaquest Pool Systems brings the early review trust forward and gives it a more polished, builder-ready presentation.
text_line: 12 five-star reviews and no website. 30-sec SuperSite demo for Seaquest.
call_script: Hey, this is Bryan with JAWSAI. Seaquest Pool Systems is at 5.0 with 12 reviews and no website. I built a quick demo - reviews up front, after-hours capture, follow-up so nothing goes cold. 30 seconds.
section_title: A SuperSite that helps a newer builder feel more established.
section_copy: With a smaller but strong review base, the site should help homeowners feel that the business is credible, active, and ready for the next project.

review_quotes.quote: Seaquest Pool Systems provides a reliable and efficient pool service. The team is friendly and professional, and they always go the extra mile.
review_quotes.author: Gary Geiger

review_quotes.quote: They were professional and efficient, and my pool has never looked better.
review_quotes.author: Anthony Tavaglione

review_quotes.quote: The technicians are knowledgeable and thorough, and they always ensure my pool is in excellent condition.
review_quotes.author: Joseph Vuong
